request_summary: Coordinate the read-only in-chat review of every feature file under src/integration.

actions.description: Enumerated the 36 integration feature files, identified PowerShell, and captured their pre-review state.
Delegated the bounded read-only review to QA analyst using the Claude Sonnet 5 model declared in frontmatter.
Verified representative findings including the literal flow_name placeholder, mixed-language steps, malformed title, missing steps, scenario count, and confirmed all files had no review-time changes.

outcome.detail: Direct source inspection confirmed the principal findings and the requested feature files remained unchanged.
